# What docs.yml's `markdown` job watches, as git pathspecs: every Markdown
# file, and what decides how they are checked -- the link checker, and
# Prettier's configuration and version.
#
# This is the only check a change of prose alone gets: ci.txt and rust-ci.txt
# both exclude it, since it cannot change what they test.
#
# Read by that workflow's `changes` job and by `just check-workflow-gates`.

scripts/check-markdown-links.mjs
.prettierrc.json
.prettierignore
package.json
bun.lock
.github/workflows/docs.yml
.github/workflows/paths/markdown.txt
